name: PDF
author: Maximilian-Maag
description: A native, keyboard-driven PDF application for Omarchy: a qutebrowser-shaped viewer with a vim workflow (hint mode, :command bar, /search, marks), full ISO 32000 rendering via PDFium, outline/links/selection, dark/light render toggle, and forms/annotate/redact/OCR/sign writing.

features: Native Qt/PDFium viewer (vim workflow): hjkl scroll, gg/G, half/full page, zoom, rotate
qutebrowser-shaped chrome: ':' command bar with completion, '/' incremental search with n/N, f hint mode over links, outline sidebar, status bar
Spec-complete rendering through PDFium (QtPdf): all filters, fonts, colour, transparency, encryption revisions, page labels/boxes
Outline, internal/external links, text selection + yank, metadata, password unlocks, printing, embedded attachments, optional-content layers
Write side: AcroForm fill + save, annotation authoring, real rasterising redaction, tesseract OCR text layer, PKCS#7 verify + QES via sign-me
Follows the applied Omarchy theme (reads colors.toml); Super+Ctrl+N dark/light render toggle
